title: Maa Fatima
body:
Maa Fatima..
Ya fatima yeh rizq hai jitna mere ghar mein..(2)
sab aapke bacho'n ka hai sadqa mere ghar mein
Ya Tahira, Ya Marziya, Ya Fatima..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Roshan hai diya jashn e wila ka mere ghar mein..(2)
hai roshni..(2), suraj se ziyada mere ghar mein
sab aapke bacho'n ka hai sadqa mere ghar mein
Ya Tahira, Ya Marziya, Ya Fatima..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Utra hai koi noori qabila mere ghar mein..(2)
har samt hai..(2), jannat ka nazara mere ghar mein
sab aapke bacho'n ka hai sadqa mere ghar mein
Ya Tahira, Ya Marziya, Ya Fatima..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hai nasb alam hazrat e abbas ka chhat par..(2)
dakhil nahi..(2), hosakta andhera mere ghar mein
sab aapke bacho'n ka hai sadqa mere ghar mein
Ya Tahira, Ya Marziya, Ya Fatima..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hai aaj mere ghar pe fida arsh ka har ghar..(2)
aaya hai..(2), Mohammad ka gharana mere ghar mein\
sab aapke bacho'n ka hai sadqa mere ghar mein
Ya Tahira, Ya Marziya, Ya Fatima..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Mushkil ko kaha naade ali padhke yeh maine..(2)
dobara..(2), palat kar nahi aana mere ghar mein
sab aapke bacho'n ka hai sadqa mere ghar mein
Ya Tahira, Ya Marziya, Ya Fatima..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Hai ne'matein jitni bhi wo hai bakhshish e Zahra..(2)
wallah nahi..(2), kuch bhi to mera mere ghar mein
sab aapke bacho'n ka hai sadqa mere ghar mein
Ya Tahira, Ya Marziya, Ya Fatima..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Aye bint e payambar tere har ek udoo par..(2)
hota hai..(2), shabo roz tabarra mere ghar mein
sab aapke bacho'n ka hai sadqa mere ghar mein
Ya Tahira, Ya Marziya, Ya Fatima..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Sab shadmaa'n hai aaj sohail ehle mawaddat..(2)
maujood hai..(2), khud Fatima Zahra mere ghar mein
sab aapke bacho'n ka hai sadqa mere ghar mein
Ya Tahira, Ya Marziya, Ya Fatima..(2)
